findings.title: A streamed cut upgrades its case lock after mapping/area locks, creating two deadlock cycles
findings.impact: Niagara/Halifax early drawing can abort a cut or mapping publication; concurrent recording can fail.
findings.qualification: Deadlock aborts preserve originals; repeated collisions can spend failure retries.
paths: packages/server/src/modules/areas/areas.ts:410-419 takes case FOR UPDATE even when site_id already matches.
packages/server/src/modules/usp/jobs.ts:253-255 takes the mapping job FOR UPDATE.
packages/server/src/modules/areas/areas.ts:1707-1737 takes case SHARE, package UPDATE, then area UPDATE.
mappingSchedule: Raw file/profile sealed; whole-file key check matched; approved mapping still running with published chunks.
Cut A passes the open gate, holds mapping job SHARE, and prepares a proved part under case SHARE.
Next publication B takes case SHARE, then waits for A's mapping-job SHARE at its job FOR UPDATE.
A reaches bindRetainedCaseTx and waits for case FOR UPDATE behind B: a closed wait cycle.
commitSchedule: Cut A holds the existing destination area/site; earlier package P belongs to the same case and area.
Commit B takes that case SHARE and P UPDATE, then waits for A's area UPDATE.
A requests case FOR UPDATE during binding, even for an already-bound case: a closed wait cycle.

findings.title: Whole-file preflight can expire a progressing attempt before its first heartbeat
findings.impact: A slow raw-chunk scan can fail before any package; its case stays write-locked meanwhile.
findings.input: Eight unchanged public Uttam features in eight raw slots; each storage read progresses for 23 s.
findings.proof: Execute production comparePrefix/heartbeat and actual attempt fence with a simulated clock.
findings.observed: 184000 ms, eight reads, zero heartbeats, expired-completion refusal, no stored check.
findings.comparison: Only changing scratch batch width from eight to one: four heartbeats and the check is stored.
findings.limitations: Injected storage duration, not a measured practice-kit rate or a claim this caused run 8.
findings.next: Bound/move raw I/O outside lock scopes and renew between bounded scopes; retain the post-read fence.
